latest_release.name: v0.9.5-rc01
latest_release.body:
_Changes since v0.9.5-beta04_

## ✨ Highlights

### 1. Progressive Blur Header & Actions for `GlassBottomSheet` (`miuix-glass` & `miuix-ui`)

- **`GlassBottomSheet` Progressive Blur Header**: Added overlaid header, `headerBottomContent`, and `scrollOffset` support to `BottomSheetOverlayLayout` and `GlassBottomSheet`, extracting `GlassHeaderContext` to share floating header button/tab behavior with `GlassTopAppBar` (`c262ff7c`).
- **Progressive Blur Polish**: Smoothed the progressive blur top scrim in `GlassTopAppBar` and `GlassBottomSheet` (`c217b445`), clamped `heightOffset` against `NaN` and out-of-bounds values (`d2e52284`), and reduced `GlassTopAppBar` default `BandOverhang` to `32.dp` (`ae3be934`).

---

## 📋 Full Changelog

### Features

- **miuix-glass / miuix-ui**: Add progressive blur header, `headerBottomContent`, `scrollOffset`, and `GlassHeaderContext` to `GlassBottomSheet` and `BottomSheetOverlayLayout` (`c262ff7c`)

### Fixes

- **miuix-glass**: Improve dynamic color contrast for `GlassTextField`, `GlassCard`, and `GlassDialogButton` ([#497](https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix/pull/497))
- **miuix-glass**: Smooth progressive blur top scrim in `GlassTopAppBar` and `GlassBottomSheet` (`c217b445`)
- **miuix-glass**: Clamp `heightOffset` in `GlassTopAppBarLayout` progressive blur (`d2e52284`)
- **miuix-glass**: Reduce `GlassTopAppBar` default `BandOverhang` to `32.dp` (`ae3be934`)
- **miuix-glass**: Preserve closing rebound on anchor button (`03d15786`)
- **miuix-ui**: Extend bottom sheet surface directly on upward overscroll (`0f2f05a9`)
- **miuix-ui**: Reset predictive back state on dialog and sheet open/close (`b5d2d698`)

### Example & Documentation

- **example**: Improve icon search ranking, scroll reset, and top bar collapse (`48bd11c7`)
- **example**: Fix `GlassPage` scroll-end haptic and bottom bar padding (`9c256923`)
- **example**: Set `GlassBottomSheet` card spacing to `12.dp` (`6bf1a4b0`)
- **example / docs**: Add `GlassBottomSheet` pager, header actions, and `headerBottomContent` demo and sync docs (`c262ff7c`)
- **example**: Add `GlassTextField` to `GlassHalfBottomSheetDemo` ([#497](https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix/pull/497))

### Baseline Profiles

- **library / example**: Update baseline and startup profiles on API 37 and cover all pager tabs (`542463a0`)

---

## ✨ 高光 (Highlights)

### 1. `GlassBottomSheet` 渐进模糊头部与操作栏 (`miuix-glass` & `miuix-ui`)

- **`GlassBottomSheet` 渐进模糊头部**：为 `BottomSheetOverlayLayout` 与 `GlassBottomSheet` 新增悬浮头部、`headerBottomContent` 与 `scrollOffset` 支持，并提取 `GlassHeaderContext` 与 `GlassTopAppBar` 共享浮动头部按钮/标签页行为（`c262ff7c`）。

---

## 📋 完整更新日志 (Full Changelog)

### 新增功能 (Features)

- **miuix-glass / miuix-ui**：为 `GlassBottomSheet` 与 `BottomSheetOverlayLayout` 新增渐进模糊头部、`headerBottomContent`、`scrollOffset` 与 `GlassHeaderContext`（`c262ff7c`）

### 修复 (Fixes)

- **miuix-glass**：优化 `GlassTextField`、`GlassCard` 与 `GlassDialogButton` 的动态取色对比度 ([#497](https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix/pull/497))
- **miuix-glass**：平滑 `GlassTopAppBar` 与 `GlassBottomSheet` 的渐进模糊顶部遮罩（`c217b445`）
- **miuix-glass**：钳位 `GlassTopAppBarLayout` 渐进模糊中的 `heightOffset`（`d2e52284`）
- **miuix-glass**：将 `GlassTopAppBar` 默认 `BandOverhang` 缩减至 `32.dp`（`ae3be934`）
- **miuix-glass**：保留锚点按钮上的关闭回弹效果（`03d15786`）
- **miuix-ui**：在向上越界滚动时直接延伸底部抽屉表面（`0f2f05a9`）
- **miuix-ui**：在弹窗与底部抽屉打开/关闭时重置预测性返回状态（`b5d2d698`）

### 示例应用与文档 (Example & Documentation)

- **示例应用**：优化图标搜索排序、滚动位置重置与顶部栏折叠行为（`48bd11c7`）
- **示例应用**：修复 `GlassPage` 滚动到底部触感反馈与底部栏内边距（`9c256923`）
- **示例应用**：将 `GlassBottomSheet` 卡片间距设为 `12.dp`（`6bf1a4b0`）
- **示例应用 / 文档**：新增 `GlassBottomSheet` 分页、头部操作与 `headerBottomContent` 演示并同步文档（`c262ff7c`）
- **示例应用**：在 `GlassHalfBottomSheetDemo` 中新增 `GlassTextField` ([#497](https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix/pull/497))

### 基线配置文件 (Baseline Profiles)

- **库 / 示例应用**：在 API 37 上更新基线与启动配置文件并覆盖所有分页标签（`542463a0`）

**Full Changelog**: https:/
